profile_text.body:
Amazon is listed as a for-profit public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States, with its website at amazon.com. No product descriptions from the company's own site were available, and no products are tracked under its name.

Four MCP servers are listed in connection with Amazon, all of them third-party integrations rather than company offerings. One, ai.sellermate/amazon-ads, is described as a remote MCP server that lets a user ask an Amazon Ads account questions and act with guardrails, using OAuth and free to connect. Two others, ai.trendsapi/amazon and ai.trendsmcp/amazon, provide Amazon product search volume, best-seller trends, and search demand over time with growth for any keyword, each offering a free key. The fourth, app.apiguru/amazon-data, is described as supplying live Amazon product, review, search, deal, offer and stock, and seller data across 20 marketplaces.

On litigation, Amazon's tracked law exposure is concentrated in Washington, where 97 matters are listed. A case is also recorded in the District Court, D. Delaware, named Haugland v. Anthropic PBC.
